name: [XMAS] Don't Wake the Brainrots!
desc:
Shh... Don't wake the brainrots! 🤫

Sneak around and steal brainrots while they sleep! 😴
Escape when you wake them up and they start chasing! 🏃‍♂️
Survive and collect as many brainrots as possible! ⚡

If you're having fun, remember to hit the thumbs up! 👍
